app_fee.value: The graduate school fee is $75 for each application, paid online after the form is submitted.
app_fee.quote: The MCGS application fee is $75 and may be paid online after submitting your application form

fee_waiver.value: Waivers are narrow: BC students and employees, military and veterans, certain volunteers, McNair Scholars, and applicants with proven serious financial hardship. Currency rates alone do not count.
fee_waiver.quote: Applicants for whom the application fee would constitute a serious financial hardship may also request a fee waiver | currency exchange rates, and/or difficulties in remitting credit card payment will not constitute 'serious financial hardship' on their own

gre_general.value: The graduate school leaves GRE General to each department, so the program record gives the rule.
gre_general.quote: If applying to a program requiring GRE scores, official GRE score reports must be submitted to complete applications

toefl_min.value: TOEFL iBT minimum is 100 (5.0 on the new scale).
toefl_min.quote: A score of 100 (5.0 on the new scale) or higher on the TOEFL iBT test

ielts_min.value: IELTS minimum is an overall band of 7.0.
ielts_min.quote: 7.0 or higher on the IELTS test

english_waiver.value: A degree from an institution whose official language of instruction is English waives the test once an official transcript shows the degree. An English-medium Indian degree can qualify on that basis.
english_waiver.quote: You earned your prior college or university degree in the U.S. or one of the countries listed above or at an institution whose official language of instruction is English

notes: Official Morrissey Graduate School doctoral list: Biology (Molecular and Cellular Biology), Chemistry, Computer Science, Earth and Environmental Sciences, Mathematics, Physics, Psychology and Neuroscience. No engineering, astronomy, materials, biomedical or data-science PhD is listed. Lynch School Measurement, Evaluation, Statistics and Assessment PhD is education measurement, so no statistics record. Physics overrides the English waiver with a country-based rule.
